articles.title: School Bus–Sized Octopuses Ruled the Dino Seas!
articles.summary: Imagine an octopus as long as a school bus! New jaw fossils show that giant octopuses, bigger than any ocean predator of their time, lived over 72 million years ago.

articles.title: This Smart Rover Just Drove Itself 16 Miles in the Desert!
articles.summary: NASA's new rover, ERNEST, can think for itself! It just drove 16 miles through a California desert all on its own, using smart wheels and AI to handle tricky ground.

articles.title: Catch the Sun's Disappearing Act: Best Spanish Cities for the 2026 Eclipse!
articles.summary: On August 12, 2026, the moon will completely cover the sun over northern Spain. Find out which cities will see the sky turn dark—and why Madrid and Barcelona will miss the show!
